class_packages_kind_fields.name: class_packages_kind_fields
class_packages_kind_fields.value:
("class_packages"."kind" = 'credit_bundle'
          AND "class_packages"."credits" IS NOT NULL
          AND "class_packages"."validity_days" IS NOT NULL
          AND "class_packages"."duration_months" IS NULL)
        OR
        ("class_packages"."kind" = 'unlimited'
          AND "class_packages"."credits" IS NULL
          AND "class_packages"."validity_days" IS NULL
          AND "class_packages"."duration_months" IS NOT NULL)
        OR
        ("class_packages"."kind" = 'trial'
          AND "class_packages"."credits" IS NOT NULL
          AND "class_packages"."validity_days" IS NOT NULL
          AND "class_packages"."duration_months" IS NULL)

client_packages_kind_fields.name: client_packages_kind_fields
client_packages_kind_fields.value:
("client_packages"."kind" = 'unlimited'
          AND "client_packages"."location_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND "client_packages"."duration_months" IS NOT NULL)
        OR
        ("client_packages"."kind" <> 'unlimited'
          AND "client_packages"."location_id" IS NULL
          AND "client_packages"."duration_months" IS NULL
          AND "client_packages"."cross_location_paid_sgd" IS NULL
          AND "client_packages"."expires_at" IS NOT NULL)

promo_codes_kind_fields.name: promo_codes_kind_fields
promo_codes_kind_fields.value:
("promo_codes"."kind" = 'percent'
          AND "promo_codes"."percent_off" IS NOT NULL
          AND "promo_codes"."percent_off" BETWEEN 1 AND 99
          AND "promo_codes"."amount_off_sgd" IS NULL)
        OR
        ("promo_codes"."kind" = 'amount'
          AND "promo_codes"."amount_off_sgd" IS NOT NULL
          AND "promo_codes"."amount_off_sgd" > 0
          AND "promo_codes"."percent_off" IS NULL)

promotions_kind_fields.name: promotions_kind_fields
promotions_kind_fields.value:
("promotions"."kind" = 'percent'
          AND "promotions"."percent_off" IS NOT NULL
          AND "promotions"."percent_off" BETWEEN 1 AND 99
          AND "promotions"."special_price_sgd" IS NULL)
        OR
        ("promotions"."kind" = 'special_price'
          AND "promotions"."special_price_sgd" IS NOT NULL
          AND "promotions"."percent_off" IS NULL)

bookings_kind_class_fk.name: bookings_kind_class_fk
bookings_kind_class_fk.value: "bookings"."kind" <> 'class' OR ("bookings"."class_id" IS NOT NULL AND "bookings"."workshop_id" IS NULL AND "bookings"."pt_session_id" IS NULL)

bookings_kind_workshop_fk.name: bookings_kind_workshop_fk
bookings_kind_workshop_fk.value: "bookings"."kind" <> 'workshop' OR ("bookings"."workshop_id" IS NOT NULL AND "bookings"."workshop_tier_id" IS NOT NULL AND "bookings"."class_id" IS NULL AND "bookings"."pt_session_id" IS NULL)

bookings_kind_pt_fk.name: bookings_kind_pt_fk
bookings_kind_pt_fk.value: "bookings"."kind" <> 'pt' OR ("bookings"."pt_session_id" IS NOT NULL AND "bookings"."class_id" IS NULL AND "bookings"."workshop_id" IS NULL)

bookings_kind_money.name: bookings_kind_money
bookings_kind_money.value:
("bookings"."kind" = 'workshop' AND "bookings"."list_price_sgd" IS NOT NULL AND "bookings"."amount_paid_sgd" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("bookings"."kind" <> 'workshop' AND "bookings"."list_price_sgd" IS NULL AND "bookings"."amount_paid_sgd" IS NULL)
